notes.title: Give MNM-1 its own stable
notes.text: Give MNM-1 its own stable USB/package identity, FM-1_61000100, so firmware hubs can distinguish it from other firmware. Sound, controls and saved-data formats are unchanged.

notes.text: Publish a GitHub release with the firmware package and a directly linked 240 × 240 screen capture.
